description: This file defines the USBDevice class and its nested Notification class, which implement plugin and USB device notification functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes interface implementations, external dependencies, and method declarations related to USB device events.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing USB device notifications and lifecycle.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Handles remote connection and USB device notifications, forwarding events to the parent USBDevice instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the USBDevice plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided service shell.
